ai-writing-assistant.shows: A sample document with a selected English message to a customer next to the real AI assistant: Codex CLI is connected, the request 'Rewrite this to sound more polite…' is typed and its real three-sentence rewrite is in the result box, ready to replace the selection. The interface of the app is Vietnamese only; the text typed and returned is US English.

local-ai-setup.shows: The real local-AI setup window checking this Mac (Apple M1 Max, 32 GB RAM, 397 GB free), recommending Qwen 2.5 14B with quality, speed and language ratings, size, RAM needs, a real 'machine is busy' notice and the Install button; text stays on the Mac. The interface of the app is Vietnamese only; the text typed and returned is US English.

signed-in-ai-agents.shows: A sample document next to the AI assistant using the signed-in Claude Code CLI (no API key) with model Haiku and a thinking level chosen in the header; it turned a casual note into a real friendly customer email. The interface of the app is Vietnamese only; the text typed and returned is US English.

ai-image-generation.shows: The AI assistant with Codex CLI selected, an English picture description typed and the real generated image of a glass pour-over dripper by a sunny window shown, with Save, Show, Insert image buttons, next to a blog draft. The interface of the app is Vietnamese only; the text typed and returned is US English.

prompt-snippet-library.shows: The snippet palette opened over a document with a selected note: 'tom tat' typed without diacritics finds 'Tóm tắt văn bản', with the Vietnamese prompt and {clipboard} placeholder in the preview.

restore-accidental-typing.shows: A document where a Vietnamese email was typed key by key through the real typing engine: English words file, report, email, restore, database, backup, update are back as typed instead of being turned into Vietnamese-looking text.

contextual-word-suggestions.shows: A document with 'Chị Mai xem giúp em bản thietke' typed without diacritics and the real suggestion bar under the caret offering 'thiết kế', 'thiết kế đồ họa' and 'thiết kế web' (Tab / ⌥2 / ⌥3).

smooth-vietnamese-typing.shows: A document where Vietnamese was typed through the real engine up to an unfinished last word ('viết'); the text is plain with no underline. It shows the result of the Backspace technique, not a side-by-side with the macOS input method.

custom-text-macros.shows: A sample document window in the dark theme with a Vietnamese message to customers; 'ace' was typed through the real typing engine (macro ace → 'anh chị em') and the real suggestion bar under the word offers 'anh chị em' with the Tab key.

remember-input-settings-by-app.shows: A sample Terminal window where commands (cd, git, npm, ssh, grep, git commit with unaccented Vietnamese) were typed in English mode and stay as typed, next to the real 'Ứng dụng đã ghi nhớ' window listing Terminal and Xcode = English, Notes, Safari, TextEdit = Tiếng Việt.

writing-controls.shows: The real Cài đặt › Bộ gõ window in the dark theme: Telex, Unicode, and the 'Chính tả và dấu' section with spell checking, auto-restore, oà/uý placement and sentence capitalization switched on.

caps-lock-warning.shows: Composed from offscreen renders of the real code, not a screen capture: the menu bar icon in red with Caps Lock on, the notice 'Caps Lock đang bật' near the bottom of the screen, and the Settings toggle 'Thông báo khi bật hoặc tắt Caps Lock' switched on. The switch track draws grey because the offscreen window is never active.
